title: The Passover and the Exodus

questions.question: What animal did God instruct each Israelite household to take for the Passover?
questions.explanation: Exodus 12:5 (ESV): "Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male a year old."

questions.question: What were the Israelites to do with the lamb's blood?
options: Put it on the doorposts and lintel
Pour it out on the ground
questions.correctAnswer: Put it on the doorposts and lintel
questions.explanation: Exodus 12:7 (ESV): "They shall take some of the blood and put it on the two doorposts and the lintel."

questions.question: What would happen when God saw the blood on the doorposts?
options: He would pass over that house
questions.correctAnswer: He would pass over that house
questions.explanation: Exodus 12:13 (ESV): "When I see the blood, I will pass over you."

questions.question: How many Israelite men left Egypt?
questions.explanation: Exodus 12:37 (ESV): "About six hundred thousand men on foot, besides women and children."

questions.question: What did the Egyptians give the Israelites as they left?
questions.explanation: Exodus 12:35-36 (ESV): "They asked the Egyptians for silver and gold jewelry and for clothing... Thus they plundered the Egyptians."

questions.question: How was the lamb to be prepared for eating?
options: Roasted with fire, with unleavened bread and bitter herbs
questions.correctAnswer: Roasted with fire, with unleavened bread and bitter herbs
questions.explanation: Exodus 12:8-9 (ESV): "They shall eat the flesh that night, roasted on the fire; with unleavened bread and bitter herbs."

questions.question: How many days was the Feast of Unleavened Bread to last?
questions.explanation: Exodus 12:15 (ESV): "Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread."

questions.question: On what day of the month was the Passover lamb to be killed?
questions.explanation: Exodus 12:6 (ESV): "The whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill their lambs at twilight on the fourteenth day."

questions.question: How long had Israel been in Egypt?
questions.explanation: Exodus 12:40 (ESV): "The time that the people of Israel lived in Egypt was 430 years."

questions.question: What happened to any meat left until morning?
options: It was to be burned with fire
It was given to the poor
questions.correctAnswer: It was to be burned with fire
questions.explanation: Exodus 12:10 (ESV): "You shall let none of it remain until the morning; anything that remains until the morning you shall burn."

questions.question: How were the Israelites to eat the Passover meal?
options: With belt fastened, sandals on, staff in hand - in haste
questions.correctAnswer: With belt fastened, sandals on, staff in hand - in haste
questions.explanation: Exodus 12:11 (ESV): "In this manner you shall eat it: with your belt fastened, your sandals on your feet, and your staff in your hand. And you shall eat it in haste."

questions.question: What instruction was given about breaking the lamb's bones?
options: You shall not break any of its bones
questions.correctAnswer: You shall not break any of its bones
questions.explanation: Exodus 12:46 (ESV): "You shall not break any of its bones."

questions.question: What did the Israelites take with them because they were driven out in haste?
questions.explanation: Exodus 12:39 (ESV): "They baked unleavened cakes of the dough... for it was not leavened, because they were thrust out of Egypt."

questions.question: Could a foreigner participate in the Passover?
options: No foreigner could eat it unless circumcised
questions.correctAnswer: No foreigner could eat it unless circumcised
questions.explanation: Exodus 12:48 (ESV): "If a stranger shall sojourn with you and would keep the Passover to the Lord, let all his males be circumcised."

questions.question: What did Moses carry out of Egypt with them?
questions.explanation: Exodus 13:19 (ESV): "Moses took the bones of Joseph with him, for Joseph had made the sons of Israel solemnly swear."

key_verse_text: The blood shall be a sign for you, on the houses where you are. And when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and no plague will befall you to destroy you, when I strike the land of Egypt.
